title: User-driven Pionex 1D / 4H historical pagination, unlimited locally retained backfill
changes: Pionex endTime pagination for 1D and 4H triggered only by leftward chart navigation or wheel zoom near loaded oldest candles; no additional initial fetch.
Retain all fetched user history across normal 60-second 1D/4H refresh and preserve global floating viewport coordinates when prepending older candles.
Keep initial IndexedDB startup cache bounded; load and persist separate deep-history cache only after user navigation.
Render only the visible candle range plus a panning buffer, so years of available OHLC do not create thousands of offscreen SVG nodes.
Use the existing main Cloudflare Worker to forward endTime to Pionex; never invent candles or substitute exchange proxy for historical pages.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite eight files in MultiAssetLiquidityRadar and deploy cloudflare/worker.js to the existing SState Worker. Older pages cannot work without updating that Worker.
validationNote: Source-level and mocked-browser tests; actual Pionex historical depth depends on symbol and endpoint data retention.
